name: swim leg circle
description: A lying leg circle drill with a swimming-style rhythm. It loosens the hips and trains the glutes and core control.
instructions: Lie face down with your arms extended in front of you.
Lift one leg slightly off the floor.
Draw small, controlled circles with that leg.
Reverse the direction after several circles.
Lower the leg and repeat on the other side.
Keep your hips pressed down and your core braced.
